name: Chronicles of Mystery: The Scorpio Ritual

locations.note: Sylvie Leroux's story begins in Paris before she travels to Malta.
Sylvie investigates her uncle's disappearance in Valletta.
On Gozo Sylvie uses a fake ID, drugs a police officer with coffee and finds the temple generator, and in the finale sets four stone pillars in the order of the planets.
Sylvie sends the owner's car rolling into a crash to distract the guards, takes four stone cubes from an art gallery, and is knocked out and thrown out.
Sylvie reaches the Vatican by a hidden passage dressed as a nun, breaks into the Cardinal's study and opens a safe behind a painting, finding a ring and papers.

routes.name: Sylvie's investigation
routes.note: From Paris to Malta and Gozo, with trips to Istanbul and the Vatican between visits.
